# Grow a Garden Calculator

> Free fan-made calculators, value lists and guides for the Roblox game Grow a Garden: exact crop values by weight, pet values by weight and age, mutation multipliers, trade checks and seed-profit tools. Data comes from the site's own stored data files, not from live game readings.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Values on this site are estimates. Each crop page states its stored base price and the date its data file last changed; the estimate formula is base price x weight squared x mutation multipliers x (1 + friend boost) x quantity.
- Mutation multipliers combine multiplicatively (for example, Golden x20 and Rainbow x50 combine to x1,000). The mutation stacking guide explains the full method.
- This is a fan-made tool. It is not affiliated with Roblox or the makers of Grow a Garden, and its values are not live in-game prices or player trade prices.
- The canonical entry point is the homepage. Calculators are interactive tools; value, pet and mutation pages are the reference data behind them.

## Calculators

Interactive tools. Each one uses the site's stored data and shows its working.

- [Grow a Garden Calculator](https://growagardencalcs.com): Free Grow a Garden calculators: crop values by weight, pet values, mutation multipliers and trade checks.
- [Crop Calculator](https://growagardencalcs.com/crop-calculator): Crop value calculator: exact crop values by weight, mutations and friend boost.
- [Pet Calculator](https://growagardencalcs.com/pet-calculator): Pet calculator: estimate pet values by weight and age.
- [Trade Calculator](https://growagardencalcs.com/trade-calculator): Trade calculator: check whether a trade is a win, fair or a loss.
- [Mutation Calculator](https://growagardencalcs.com/mutation-calculator): Mutation calculator: stack mutation multipliers on a crop value.
- [Reverse Goal Calculator](https://growagardencalcs.com/reverse-calculator): Reverse goal calculator: work out the weight needed to hit a target coin amount.
- [Seed Combiner](https://growagardencalcs.com/seed-combiner): Seed combiner: calculator and fruit mechanics.
- [Seed Profit Calculator](https://growagardencalcs.com/seed-profit): Seed profit calculator: best crops by return on investment.
- [Elephant Calculator](https://growagardencalcs.com/elephant-calculator): Elephant value calculator: estimate an elephant pet's value.
- [Value List](https://growagardencalcs.com/value-list): Full pet and crop values list.

## Guides

Reference guides for mutations, updates and events.

- [Mutation Guide](https://growagardencalcs.com/mutation-guide): Mutations guide: 172+ mutation multipliers explained.
- [Mutation Stacking Guide](https://growagardencalcs.com/mutation-stacking-guide): Mutation stacking guide: how multipliers combine, with worked examples.
- [Aurora Mutation](https://growagardencalcs.com/aurora-mutation): Aurora mutation guide: ×90 multiplier.
- [Fairy Update](https://growagardencalcs.com/fairy-update): Fairy update guide: pets, chests and rewards.
- [Ghoul Garden Halloween Event](https://growagardencalcs.com/ghoul-garden-halloween-event): Ghoul Garden Halloween event archive.
